articles.summary: The second partnership between the outdoor footwear brand and London-based label reimagines Merrell’s iconic slide silhouette in two premium suede colorways. ROCKFORD, Mich., Sept. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Merrell, the global outdoor footwear brand, and London-based fashion brand YMC come together for the second time to launch new colours of the Moab 2 Slide x YMC. Available in Black and Dark Walnut, the limited-edition collaboration brings YMC’s understated, utility-led design language to a Merrell icon built for comfort, versatility and everyday wear. YMC, short for “You Must Create,” is both a mission statement and a call to action. Founded in 1995, the brand is known for thoughtful, functional design drawing influence from workwear, subculture, music and art. In its latest partnership with Merrell, YMC brings their creative point of view to the Moab 2 Slide, balancing the silhouette’s outdoor DNA with premium materials and an elevated finish.
